# JSS Mauritius MBBS — GooCampus

> MBBS abroad at JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research, Mauritius — a
> 5-year, NMC-aligned, English-medium MBBS programme for Indian students.
> Recognised by the Higher Education Commission of Mauritius and backed by
> JSS Mahavidyapeetha (360+ institutions).

## Programme
- Title: MBBS at JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research, Mauritius
- URL: https://goocampus-hr-portal.onrender.com/jss-mauritius
- Duration: 5 years, full-time, on-campus
- Medium of instruction: English
- Curriculum: Competency-Based Medical Education (CBME), aligned with the
  National Medical Commission (NMC) of India
- Clinical training: From Semester 3; 1,200+ bed exposure
- Teaching hours: 6,355 across the programme
- Recognition: Higher Education Commission of Mauritius;
  CBME curriculum aligned to NMC India (graduates eligible for FMGE / NExT)
- Intake: 2026 batch — applications open
- Eligibility: Class 12 with PCB; NEET-UG qualified (2025 or 2026)

## Institution
- Name: JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research, Mauritius
- Type: Degree-awarding autonomous university
- Location: Vacoas-Phoenix, Mauritius
- Parent: JSS Mahavidyapeetha (https://jssonline.org/)
- Reference institution: JSS Medical College, Mysuru, India

## Counselling Partner
- Name: GooCampus
- Role: Indian student admissions, counselling, and application support
- Website: https://goocampusglobal.com
- Contact: neha@goocampus.in
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Target audience: Indian students after Class 12 / NEET-UG candidates
  seeking MBBS abroad with an NMC-aligned, English-medium pathway.
